transcript: Who is the CM of West Bengal?
response:
Suvendu Adhikari is the Chief Minister of West Bengal. He has been serving as the ninth chief minister of West Bengal since nine May two thousand twenty-six, and is the first chief minister from the Bharatiya Janata Party to hold the office. Mamata Banerjee served as the eighth chief minister from two thousand eleven to two thousand twenty-six.
